class.name: QuantumDarwinismGeneratorNode
class.brief_description: Standalone SceneTree host node for outward multi-channel Quantum Darwinism procedural generation.
class.description: Owns a `ProceduralEnvironment` and `QuantumDarwinismSolver` (with optional `WFCSolverNode` interoperability), allowing landmark and partial-channel seeding, outward wavefront stepping/solving, solved configuration export, and live Godot SceneTree write-back via `apply_resolved_channels_to_object_tree`.

members.member: Number of slots in the standalone ProceduralEnvironment.
Optional ProceduralPattern providing tokens and cascading GenerationRules.
Optional NodePath to a WFCSolverNode to share its ProceduralEnvironment for hybrid WFC+QD workflows.
